Despite the EU's wealth of researchers and expertise, he warns that Europe is struggling to turn these resources into "real technological and industrial scale." news.title: Roger Waters launches heartfelt plea for 'an end to the genocide in Gaza'
news.summary: Pink Floyd co-founder Roger Waters has always mixed art with activism. A long-standing supporter of the Palestinian cause, the star guitarist has now released a re-imagined version of the rock anthem "Comfortably Numb" with Palestinian American singer Mona Miari singing in Arabic. He tells FRANCE 24's Lyana Saleh why proceeds of the record are going to the Palestine Children's Relief Fund and why he can never become "Comfortably Numb" with the violence and suffering in Gaza.

news.title: US, Ukraine say Europe to join peace talks as Putin sticks to hardline stance
news.summary: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky and US envoy Jared Kushner said Thursday, November 12, Europe would join the next round of talks with Russia, as Vladimir Putin indicated Moscow will not compromise on its hardline demands to end almost five years of war. In a packed day of shuttle diplomacy following negotiations in Abu Dhabi, Kushner and fellow envoy Steve Witkoff held over four hours of talks with Putin in the Kremlin before jetting to debrief Zelensky in Dublin.

news.title: Fallout from Nvidia scandal spreads as Huang resigns
news.summary: Jensen Huang resigned as chief executive of Nvidia on Thursday after revelations of extramarital affairs, including one with a woman accused of spying for China. The news wiped 4.3% of Nvidia’s share price by closing bell Thursday, while the scandal has also raised concerns over security in the United States, with the spotlight falling on US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick.
